description: This file contains command-line interface structures for microphone management, including listing available microphone devices and setting the default input device. It utilizes AVFoundation for device discovery and integrates with a command parser framework.

classes.name: MicCommand
classes.description: Main command grouping for microphone-related subcommands.

classes.name: MicList
classes.description: Implements listing of available microphone input devices.

classes.name: MicSet
classes.description: Implements setting a microphone device as default based on index or configuration.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the listing of microphone devices or setting the default device based on given arguments.
